ggsegAAL: Automated Anatomical Labeling atlases

Source: R/ggsegAAL-package.R
ggsegAAL-package.Rd

The ggsegAAL package provides AAL1, AAL2 and AAL3 representations for the ggseg ecosystem.

Details

The atlas family is divided into cortical, subcortical and cerebellar components.

Atlas composition

  • AAL1: 82 cortical + 8 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 116 regions.

  • AAL2: 86 cortical, including the AAL2 orbitofrontal parcellation, + 8 subcortical + 26 cerebellar = 120 regions.

  • AAL3: 90 cortical, including anterior cingulate subdivisions, + 50 subcortical, including thalamic subdivisions, + 26 cerebellar = 166 regions.

Representations

Cortical atlases are represented on the Colin27 cortical surface.

Subcortical atlases include a contextual cortical representation for 2D plotting.

Cerebellar atlases are transformed to SUIT space and provide flatmap and 3D representations.

References

Rolls, E. T., Huang, C. C., Lin, C. P., Feng, J., & Joliot, M. (2020). Automated anatomical labelling atlas 3. NeuroImage, 206. PubMed

Rolls, E. T., Joliot, M., & Tzourio-Mazoyer, N. (2015). Implementation of a new parcellation of the orbitofrontal cortex in the automated anatomical labeling atlas. NeuroImage, 122, 1-5. PubMed

Tzourio-Mazoyer, N., Landeau, B., Papathanassiou, D., Crivello, F., Étard, O., Delcroix, N., Mazoyer, B., & Joliot, M. (2002). Automated Anatomical Labeling of Activations in SPM Using a Macroscopic Anatomical Parcellation of the MNI MRI Single-Subject Brain. NeuroImage, 15, 273-289. PubMed
